name: Apex Algs Again 2026
information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApexAlgsAgain2026#73021-competitor-information) prior to registering**.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

**Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring TWO guests with them to the competition. Yes, parents and siblings count as guests.**

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApexAlgsAgain2026#73026-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDM1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d9cae9d8ff46f8d2ea459941cb151cadd0782269/SOUTHEAST_5%20(1).png)

This competition is also in partnership with [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/)! They will be providing gift card codes to their website to the podium finishers in each event.
